name: volume_profile_breakout_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, the intraday volume profile concentrates ~70% of session volume in a price band (value area) that acts as the institutional fair-value reference — VWAP-anchored and TWAP-following algorithms continuously recycle orders within this zone. The Value Area High (VAH) represents the upper supply wall built by two-way institutional flow. When NIFTY breaks and holds above VAH for two consecutive 5-second bars on a volume surge (>1.5x the 20-minute rolling baseline), it signals that resting sell orders at the VAH ceiling have been absorbed and fresh momentum-buy orders from trend-following algos and HFT systems cascade in, creating a directional burst of 15-25 spot points in the first 30-60 seconds.
core_signal_oneliner: Two consecutive 5s bars closing above intraday Volume Area High with 1.5x volume surge confirms supply absorption breakout
